test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If all the letters of the English alphabet are divided into two equal halves and the second half is written first followed by the first half, then which letter would appear at the fifth place to the right of the 11th letter from the left?
solution:
The first half of the English alphabet are:

A B C D E F G H I J K L M

The second half of the English alphabet are:

N O P Q R S T U V W X Y Z

The second half is written first followed by the first half then the series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/615f2ff6fc16a0354b983c6b4ab4bac15c3e6b72b130480b1b0e6379526a3dd5.png] 

N O P Q R S T U V W X Y Z A B C D E F G H I J K L M

The 11th letter from the left is** X **and fifth place from X is** C.**

Hence,** C** is the** correct answer.**
